rationale: Both catch the single substantive ground-truth issue (quant silently ignored on FLASHINFER_ATTN) and go well beyond it with diff-grounded findings (e.g. both independently spot the AttnQuantSpec.enabled vs QuantConfig.enabled dtype_vo mismatch region and the unrelated doc-section deletions). X demonstrates higher-confidence grounding by actually executing the reported code paths to confirm claims (backend_kwargs() outputs, QuantConfig.enabled results) and structures findings with concrete before/after code patches, making it more directly actionable; its ring-SP and output-dtype findings are sharp if unverifiable extensions beyond the diff. Y contributes genuinely valuable novel catches (CI glob not recursing into tests/diffusion/attention/, stale recipe doc) but its evidence-quote format is denser and less prescriptive about the exact fix, and a couple of claims (buildkite yml, recipe file) rest on external citations without demonstrated verification.
